narrative.synopsis: Zeus turns the liberation of his siblings into open war against Cronus. With thunder from the Cyclopes and allied divine forces, the Olympians defeat the Titans and end the old order.
narrative.openingSituation: Two generations of gods face each other after Cronus’ children are freed.
narrative.centralConflict: The Titans still possess the older claim to rule and must be displaced by force.
narrative.resolution: Zeus’ side wins and the Titans lose control of the cosmos.
narrative.outcome: The Olympian order can now be established.
